name: Haiku price momentum
strategy: Contrarian sector rotation: short overextended semiconductors (SOXL, +506% YTD extreme) paired with tactical long rotation into energy, financials, biotech, value, and EM; position-level stops (18% SL shorts) and take-profits (15-30% TP longs).

positions.thesis: Biotech rotation; increase from 12% as capital flows out of tech into overlooked value sectors.
Energy rotation; increase from 10% with macro tailwinds and relative value vs collapsed tech.
Financials rotation; increase from 10% as rotation theme accelerates post-tech crash.
Small-cap value leverage; increase from 12% for enhanced participation in rotation away from mega-cap tech.
Large-cap value core; increase from 8% to 19% as value rotation gains structural traction.
Emerging markets rotation; increase from 12% capturing geographic diversification from broken US tech concentration.
Regional banks rotation; increase from 8% as value/small-cap rotation theme deepens.

reassessment_note: Week 2 Info Desk (2026-07-25, drip protocol — released items only): SHORT SOXL thesis validated: semiconductors down -40.4% as of 2026-07-24 (vs +506% YTD peak). The +15% TP should trigger soon, locking in massive profits. Re-balancing to close the winning short and re-deploy proceeds into full-conviction rotation theme (energy/financials/biotech/value/EM) at increased position sizing, maximizing capital efficiency in the confirmed rotation-out-of-tech structural trade.
novelty: ROUND-2 rebalance retreated defensive post-momentum-collapse (tech down to 23%, cash/bonds up to 51%); ROUND-3 rebalance pivots aggressive into pure sector rotation—84% deployed in value/energy/financials/biotech/EM, 0% tech/semis, opposite direction from ROUND-2's tech shorts. Same-direction overlap is small-cap only (~15-17%, IWM vs TNA both long small-cap). Return drivers inverted: ROUND-2 preserves capital; ROUND-3 exploits rotation-into-value from tech destruction. <20% same-direction gross overlap; structural return-driver reversal.
